review.verdict:
LENS on 935aaf1 (verifier format delta against Doc 63). Read-only and NOT RUN. Recommendation: SOURCE CORRECT WITH LIMITS. I found no P0, P1 or P2. This is lens input for the original reviewer's disposition. It is not acceptance and not Samuel's approval.

**Identity.** Subject 935aaf1a679aa67d013133521dd7110f66db74a3 has tree 3a7b5d11f2c5b8d8e472185f1fe1136313c3eae6 and parent 6c3a883b. Records a8285015 has tree d8184fe6 and parent 935aaf1.

**SQL.** The .sql blob is 15d63f91 at 2d2d958, 7a62e64 and 935aaf1. Pre and postchecks are also unchanged. I recomputed sha256 over the LF install section followed by the fingerprint section: 3ca2bab80e7b7e829c965e9dcc6e8f9ac2e96720ee24701615c0c1c90b249b74.

**Source correctness, by hand-simulation over git-show bytes.** All seven new direct valid_publication pairs refuse only through their named target. Each control is valid. Removing the target term would let the negative be accepted, so the 'f' assertion would fail:
- schemaVersion v2 → sql:95
- uppercase revisionId → sql:96
- 'g'x40 sourceCommit → sql:97
- 'g'x64 bundleSha256 → sql:98
- 'g'x64 catalog artifact sha256 → sql:118
- effectiveFrom 2026-10-06T24:00:00.000Z → sql:103
- effectiveUntil of the same value → the to_char arm of sql:107

The round-trip cases are guarded by ordinary SELECTs that must succeed: normalisation to 2026-10-07T00:00:00.000Z, an equal-instant check and, for the end case, an end-after-start check. A cast failure therefore fails the verifier; it is never credited as a refusal.

**Doc 63 findings.**
- V63-1, V63-2 and V63-4 are closed in source.
- V63-6 is closed in the new closure. One typography residual remains in the bindings JSON.
- V63-3 and V63-5 are carried as disclosed limits, as the assignment directed.

**Preservation.** Removing the DOC63 case block (mjs:670-721) and the doc63Discrimination output (mjs:1100-1106), then reverting BINDINGS, reproduces the 7a62e64 verifier byte-for-byte (81,561 bytes). So the retained cases, HELD list, argv, exit codes 2/1/130/143 and receipt confinement are all unchanged.

**Records.**
- The receipt has 66 entries; all 66 match 935aaf1. Its raw sha256 is 24430f71…6a66, it is not listed in itself, and it is exactly the required union set.
- The bindings, closure, source, preservation and records JSON all recompute.
- 6c3a883..935aaf1 touches exactly the three declared paths, and 935aaf1..a828501 touches records only.
- The supervisor (8dec3860) and manifest (00eb8955) are unchanged from f98c416 through a828501.
- No execution is claimed anywhere.

**Execution eligibility: NOT PROVEN / NOT ELIGIBLE.**
- Seven authored pairs are not seven working pairs.
- PostgreSQL 17.11 handling of 24:00 has not been observed.
- The window has expired; there is no execution authority and no reservation.
- The Docker and image facts are missing.
- This delta still needs the original reviewer's exact disposition.

The later cc584f9 manifest keeps 7a62e64 as the accepted pin and lists 935aaf1 only as pending, so nothing was silently re-pinned.
